title: SPEC SYNTHESIS GATE (frontier, thinker): Addendum II record ledger, reputation.py surface, overrule-path enforcement
description: THE EPIC'S ONE GATE. Frontier tier: this is low-verifiability judgment work - no adversarial replay catches a spec that is merely imprecise, and imprecision here becomes invented constitutional material downstream. Produces docs/precedent-research/synthesis-addendum-ii-spec.md, which must fix five things precisely enough that T-369, T-370, T-371 and T-372 invent NOTHING: (1) the RECORD SET that enacts the DIRECTIVEs - titles, subjects, tiers, follows and cites relations, operations, sources tokens, and which addendum section each record enacts; (2) the reputation.py READ-ONLY CLI surface - subcommands, flags, exit codes, stdout shapes, --json, the fixed sybil caveat line, per-figure source-store attribution, and the empty-never-fabricated adjudication field; (3) the precedent.py overrule-path enforcement spec (AB5) - embed the overruled ratio verbatim with authorship, the refusal message, and how PR-009 retrofits or is grandfathered, DECIDED and JUSTIFIED here; (4) the PRECEDENT.md new-section outline; (5) the T-349 amendment note text, drafted verbatim. Depends on T-367 ONLY: T-366 validates the design against economics and history but does not gate it, and its contradictions escalate to the join T-375. Every requirement carries a stable numbered id so both verifiers can check the shipped code against your text line by line, exactly as SDR-NN and V1-NN are cited across the shipped CLI today. THINKER ROLE: no source edits, no records, no code.
acceptance_criteria: OWNS EXACTLY ONE FILE: docs/precedent-research/synthesis-addendum-ii-spec.md. THINKER ROLE - no code, no records, no edits to PRECEDENT.md or INTERPRETIVE-CODE.md, nothing under .harness/bin/. Do NOT edit synthesis-design-requirements.md, synthesis-refinements.md or synthesis-v1-requirements.md - closed artifacts of T-339, T-344 and T-352; cite them by id instead.

NUMBERED REQUIREMENTS with stable ids (declare the prefix in a header note, for example AB2-01..NN) so T-369..T-372 can cite the id in a code comment or a handoff line and T-374 can check each one mechanically. The shipped precedent.py cites SDR-NN and V1-NN this way throughout; match that convention.

THE RECORD LEDGER, one row per record, with columns: proposed TITLE and its CHARACTER COUNT (the CLI refuses titles over 80 characters - .harness/bin/precedent.py:843 - so a row with a 92-character title is a spec defect, not a worker problem); subject key; authority_tier plus the tier_evidence anchor; operation type and subtype per PRECEDENT.md section 18; follows and cites relations naming REAL live ids (the registry holds PR-001..PR-017 today); sources tokens; declared_width; scope_conditions; validity_conditions (distinct from scope, PRECEDENT.md 19.3); revisit_trigger; and THE ADDENDUM SECTION EACH RECORD ENACTS. Cover at minimum one record per DIRECTIVE: A.2 two currencies with the two attachment rules; A.3 the displacement bridge (all four numbered rules); A.4 Phase A ledger-only with the AB3 sybil caveat and the AB4 uniform-burden neutrality; A.5 the Phase B identity gate; A.6.3 the load-bearing citation with T-367's v1 heuristic marked PROVISIONAL and its decay clock; A.7 the pre-registered Phase B weighting; A.9 the refusals; C.3 territorial law with AB10's founding-domain delimitation; C.4 the sovereign cell charter; C.5 the Westphalia KPI with the operator baseline. Where you merge or split sections, state which record covers which section: a DIRECTIVE section with neither a record nor a stated subsumption is a defect.

BRUSSELS-EFFECT PARKING (AB1): the parking notice lands in the DICTA of the Part C record and nowhere else - it gets no record of its own. State the exact dicta sentence to be published, including the operator's stated precondition (the harness must demonstrably gate something cells cannot obtain elsewhere) so a future session cannot read the parking as a mere deferral of enthusiasm.

ANCHORING GRAMMAR (AB8): this addendum has NO DOI. Every record anchors via task-anchored decision tokens in the established grammar, decision:T-NNN#addendum-ii-<section>, validated against the shipped token grammar (PRECEDENT.md section 5.1 and precedent.py's citation validator) so that nothing dangles at `python3 .harness/bin/precedent.py cite --all`. State the EXACT token for each record and which T-NNN it anchors to, and state that the local docs/ path may appear only in dicta, never as a sole anchor, because docs/ is gitignored (.gitignore:33) and would dangle for every reader who clones.

THE REPUTATION.PY SURFACE, fixed verbatim: every subcommand, every flag, every exit code, the greppable stdout line shapes, and the --json shape. Quote the FIXED SYBIL CAVEAT LINE character-for-character (AB3: identities are self-asserted with FORCE-IDENTITY-A open; Phase A is bookkeeping, not currency; no consequence may cite these figures), require it on EVERY output path INCLUDING --json, and name the JSON field that carries it. Fix the AB2 event-type to source-store mapping as a table: rule authorship to published_by; load-bearing citations received to T-367's MECHANIZABLE subset; consolidations achieved to the existing C-threshold data qualified by PR-015 (only distinct-identity confirmed applications count); proper overrulings issued and sustained to overrules relations whose superseding record survived verification AND has been cited at least once (A.3.2: credit accrues on sustained, never on published); verification verdicts upheld to verdicts in blackboard and task records; adjudications not reversed DEFERRED, field present and empty, never fabricated. For each figure state the exact store path read and the attribution string printed. Honor AB2's TRADEOFF explicitly: events.jsonl carries measured synthetic contamination, so registry and task records are preferred over raw event counts - state exactly where events.jsonl is read, if at all, and why.

AB9-1 VISIBILITY REQUIREMENT: every consolidation figure must display WHO confirmed alongside it. Name the field the who comes from - confirmed_by, or the publishers of the qualifying applications counted by qualifying_applications_count - and choose ONE precisely. The two are different data (a single confirmation record versus the set of applying records) and the choice is substantive: it decides whether the author-recruits-confirmers pattern is actually visible.

ISOLATION AND READ-ONLY: fix reputation.py's test-isolation mechanism exactly as SDR-13 fixed it for precedent.py - flag name, environment-variable name, precedence (flag wins), and WHICH stores resolve under the root (precedents/, tasks/, blackboard.json, logs/events.jsonl). State as a hard requirement that reputation.py writes NOTHING, including events - the same verb class as cite, conflicts and stale, whose own DECISION notes in precedent.py say that logging one would make it the only read verb in the file with a side effect.

PHASE A NEUTRALITY (AB4), stated as a prohibition both T-371 and T-374 can test: no code path may vary any verification or confirmation burden by standing. PR-015's confirmation burden stays UNIFORM for every identity in Phase A; section A.6.2's standing-scaled trust burden is PHASE B material and is not operable now, by A.4's own words - no consequence, none. Require that reputation.py exposes nothing importable as a gate, and say in plain words that a consumer wiring a consequence to Phase A output violates a tier-1 record rather than a style guide.

THE OVERRULE-PATH ENFORCEMENT SPEC (AB5), precise enough to implement with zero invention: the exact new flag or flags and their -file variants; WHERE the embedded predecessor material is stored in the record shape (name the field path); what AUTHORSHIP means mechanically (record id, published_by, and issuing task - all three); the exact refusal message text and its exit code (1 per the shipped contract); the behavior for a DECISION-ANCHORED target, ruled explicitly, since decision:T-NNN#anchor has no published_by and no registry ratio and PR-009's own live target decision:T-344#R-2 is exactly that case; and whether the new field is a schema-version bump or an additive optional field - if a bump, name who publishes the amendment record. Also rule whether the conflicts pass gains a detector for non-compliant historical overrules, or explicitly does not (D6: conflicts is a pass, never a gate, never a hook).

THE PR-009 RULING - decide and justify in writing, do not defer. Reason explicitly against these constraints: SDR-01 makes relations immutable after publication, so a retrofit edits a field the contract freezes; PR-009 was published before the enforcement existed and its target is a decision anchor rather than a PR record; and .harness/tests/test_precedent_seed.py asserts against live records and is owned by NOBODY in this epic. If you rule RETROFIT, assign the record edit to T-369 (the only registry writer in this epic), name the seed-test impact, and name the record that authorizes the immutability exception. If you rule GRANDFATHER, state HOW the record set says so - a scope_conditions clause, a validity condition, or an explicit dicta line - so no future session can read PR-009 as a counterexample to the rule it inspired.

THE PRECEDENT.MD SECTION OUTLINE: heading, subsection list, and for each subsection the exact claims it may make, constrained to what the shipped CLI actually does. State the FREEZE RULE for T-372 in writing: quote only surfaces that exist and are frozen by T-370 and T-371, and run every command you quote. The doc-versus-code drift lesson is twice-learned on this bench (T-346 and T-360 both had to check it), which is why T-372 runs last and why its criteria demand greps rather than good intentions.

THE T-349 AMENDMENT NOTE TEXT, drafted verbatim and ready to paste, carrying AB7's two additions: (a) the A.8 reputation indicator - if load-bearing and name-drop citation counts converge, or if standing concentrates without corresponding verified work, the currency is failing and Phase B does not ship regardless of the identity gate; (b) the C.5 Westphalia KPI as a standing definition with the operator baseline on record (approximately 3 months of human effort reconciling architecture and redundancy differences between two simple systems), its measure (wall-clock hours plus tokens to reconcile two diverged domain registries), its quarterly report cadence, its interpretation rule (if reconciliation cost trends to negligible, this containment architecture is over-engineered), and the fact that it is measurable only once two domain registries exist. State that T-349 is amended BY NOTE via `blackboard.py update T-349 --note-file`, never by rewriting its acceptance criteria, and that its status stays open because a standing duty never terminates.

PUBLISH-ORDER INVARIANT, stated in plain words: T-369 publishes the record set against the CURRENTLY SHIPPED CLI, before T-370's enforcement exists, because PR-017's procedure puts the record before the code. Therefore NO record in your ledger may require a flag T-370 has not built yet. If any row needs the new field, the ledger is wrong - re-cut it.

SELF-CHECK, the criterion that makes the rest real: for the reputation.py surface and for the enforcement flags, write out the EXACT command line an implementer would produce from your text and the EXACT stdout it should print. If you cannot write it, the requirement is not precise enough - fix the text; do not add a note asking the worker to decide.

SCOPE REFUSALS, restated as numbered requirements so downstream tasks inherit them: no Phase B consequence machinery; no new ledger and no stored balances (derived on read, PR-010's doctrine); no reputation for humans in the loop; no leaderboard across organizations; no automatic demotion, suspension or exclusion by computed standing alone (A.9); no cell, no domain registry and no charter built now (AB1: Part C is records only, future-binding); no Brussels-effect construction; no NLAH mutation (claude.md and gemini.md untouched, and no duty to cite imposed on any agent); no .harness/state.json write; no ORCHESTRATION.md edit.

T-366 IS NOT AN INPUT AND MUST NOT BE WAITED FOR: it validates the design, it does not gate it, and its contradictions are dispositioned at T-375. If you find yourself needing an economics finding to fix a requirement, that requirement is Phase B material and belongs in your deferral list, not in the spec.

Hand off with `python3 .harness/bin/blackboard.py handoff --to-role verifier --agent <you>` (never self-mark done). The note carries the record-ledger table, the PR-009 ruling in one sentence with its ground, the reputation.py subcommand list, and every OPEN-QUESTION you leave for the join.

DECISION: the addendum-ii decision anchors defined by this task, enumerated here on the TRACKED task
record so every decision:T-368#addendum-ii-<slug> token published by T-369 resolves to something a
later reader can reach (AB8; spec requirement AD2-02). This addendum has no DOI, and the operator
text plus the spec live under gitignored docs/, so the tracked referent for each fragment is this
list. Thirteen anchors, each naming the delimited decision it carries.

decision:T-368#addendum-ii-a2 - A.2 two currencies: patrimony is territorial (rules, registries and
doctrine belong to the domain); honor is personal (track record attaches to the identity and travels
with it across cells, domains and reassignments). The split is the completing half of territorial
law, not a contradiction: a right of exit disciplines a sovereign only if leaving costs the leaver
nothing they earned.

decision:T-368#addendum-ii-a3-1 - A.3.1 the displacement bridge as PROTOCOL: publishing with an
overrules relation requires embedding the overruled ratio verbatim together with its authorship
(record id, published_by, issuing task), stored at relations[].overruled_predecessor as an additive
optional field with four keys, no schema-version bump; refusal otherwise, exit 1. PROSPECTIVE ONLY:
it reaches no record already in the registry. A decision-anchored target supplies the quoted text,
the anchor token as the record id, the T-NNN half as the issuing task, and the fixed marker
"unavailable: decision-anchored target has no published_by" as published_by. The enforcement binds
overrules only; supersedes and voids are out of scope by AB5's delimitation.

decision:T-368#addendum-ii-a3-2-a3-4 - A.3.2 plus A.3.4: overruling credit accrues when the
displacement survives verification AND subsequent citation, never on publication; consolidation pays
the author when a rule reaches the C threshold under PR-015's distinct-identity floor; and every
consolidation figure displays WHO supplied the qualifying applications (AB9-1), so the
author-recruits-confirmers pattern is visible while it is still free to attempt.

decision:T-368#addendum-ii-a3-3 - A.3.3 silent divergence is the only reputational crime; recorded as
doctrine now, its reputational PRICE is Phase B material (AB6). Phase A counts and displays; it does
not fine.

decision:T-368#addendum-ii-a4 - A.4 Phase A is bookkeeping: derived on read, never stored as
balances, no new ledger, six event types, and NO CONSEQUENCE ATTACHES, NONE. Carries the AB3 sybil
caveat verbatim as the canonical string every reader output prints, and the AB4 neutrality clause:
the PR-015 confirmation burden stays UNIFORM for every identity in Phase A, and A.6.2's
standing-scaled trust burden is Phase B material.

decision:T-368#addendum-ii-a5 - A.5 Phase B is gated on cryptographic identity with an external trust
root. Sybil minting closes there and nowhere else. The gate is conjunctive with the A.8 indicator:
even with the gate closed, Phase B does not ship if the currency is failing.

decision:T-368#addendum-ii-a6-3 - A.6.3 the load-bearing citation, with T-367's v1 heuristic adopted
as PROVISIONAL doctrine plus its decay clock as the record's revisit trigger. Only steps 1-4
(MECHANIZABLE) ship in Phase A; steps 5-7 print as not computed. Raw len(cited_by) is never a proxy
for load-bearing citations received.

decision:T-368#addendum-ii-a7 - A.7 the Phase B weighting, pre-registered now: adversarial work is
scarcer and must pay more. Ordering only, no numeric weights, no operative effect in Phase A.

decision:T-368#addendum-ii-a9 - A.9 the refusals: no reputation for humans in the loop, no global
leaderboard across organizations, no automatic demotion or exclusion by computed standing alone, and
a written reasoned tiered decision remains the only instrument that changes anyone's status.

decision:T-368#addendum-ii-c3 - C.3 territorial law: precedents attach to domains, never to lineages;
lineages carry no patrimony; context maps are treaties. Plus AB10: until cells exist,
.harness/precedents is the registry of the FOUNDING DOMAIN (the harness itself), satisfying the
territorial rule degenerately with a single territory, and it is not any lineage's personal-law
patrimony. Plus AB1: the Brussels-effect / conformance-acquis parking notice lives in this record's
dicta and nowhere else, with the operator's precondition on record (the harness must demonstrably
gate something cells cannot obtain elsewhere).

decision:T-368#addendum-ii-c4 - C.4 the sovereign cell charter, five clauses (jurisdiction, internal
autonomy, mutual recognition, ius emigrandi, resources follow outcomes), binding future construction
and authorizing no cell now.

decision:T-368#addendum-ii-c5 - C.5 the Westphalia KPI as a standing definition: operator baseline of
approximately 3 months of human reconciliation effort, measured in wall-clock hours plus tokens,
reported quarterly, interpreted as evidence of over-engineering if reconciliation cost trends to
negligible, and measurable only once two domain registries exist.

DECISION: PR-009 is GRANDFATHERED, not retrofitted (spec AD2-40..AD2-45). Ground: relations are
immutable under SDR-01 and the only immutability exception on record (PR-007's once-only migration)

MY THREE HARDEST CALLS:

DECISION 1 (AD2-57, board Q4): AB9-1's "who confirmed" is the PUBLISHERS OF THE QUALIFYING
APPLICATIONS, not confirmed_by. The consolidation figure is computed from
qualifying_applications_count, whose mechanical floor IS the distinct-publisher filter on applying
records, so the who must be the same data the figure is made of. confirmed_by belongs to a different
lifecycle (scope confirmation, one scalar per record) and is null on all seventeen live records, so
choosing it would have made AB9-1's whole mitigation display nothing. Substantive, not cosmetic: this
choice is what makes the author-recruits-confirmers pattern actually visible.

DECISION 2 (AD2-34, board Q2): the decision-anchor edge case is ruled as an ADAPTED EMBEDDING with the
unavailable element MARKED. Refusing decision-anchored overrules would delete a shipped capability the
live registry already exercises; exempting them would open the channel "anchor at a decision token and
skip the payment". So: the publisher supplies the quotation, the anchor token is the record id, the
T-NNN half is the issuing task and must resolve, and published_by must be EXACTLY the fixed marker
"unavailable: decision-anchored target has no published_by" - mechanically checkable, which closes the
fabrication channel because no invented identity is accepted. Named residual weakness: the
quotation's fidelity is JUDGMENT, not mechanizable (OQ-2).

TRADEOFF 3 (AD2-38 with AD2-39): the enforcement binds --overrules ONLY, and the conflicts pass gains
NO detector for non-compliant historical overrules. AB5's delimitation names --overrules, and code
that does more than its record authorizes is a REJECT at T-374 even when it is a good idea; a detector
whose entire possible population is the one record this spec already grandfathered would report the
same finding forever, which is the false-positive shape PRECEDENT.md section 9 names as fatal. The
cost is a real evasion channel: --supersedes displaces a rule without paying its author. T-374 must
score that bypass shape as CORRECT-PER-SPEC (exit 0, no embedding required) rather than as a defeated
refusal, and it is forwarded as OQ-1.
